rows.rule: article uses the 12-H2 skeleton (FAQ under H2 #12)
rows.rank_math_test: none (keywordInSubheadings needs only 1 subheading with FK)
rows.verifier: verify-article: Heading balance (any balanced count passes)
rows.source: The author's site template; see data/h2-templates.csv

rows.rule: 5 of 12 H2s carry the FK (1/2/4/6/10); pronouns elsewhere to hold density
aim for 1400+ wp.wordcount words (2000+ ideal); Rank Math itself passes from 600
rows.source: The author's site habit; earlier versions called this a Rank Math minimum (it is not)

rows.rule: FAQ block has 8 questions; 4 carry the FK
rows.source: The author's site FAQ habit; see data/faq-topics.csv

rows.rule: HowTo block has 4 steps under H2 #4
3 YouTube embeds in H2 #9; Rank Math media test counts at most 2 points for videos
5 external links in H2 #11 (first link internal category page)

rows.rank_math_test: keywordInMetaDescription only needs FK anywhere (KB: first 120-160 chars)
rows.source: The author's site habit (stricter than Rank Math)

rows.rule: rank_math_title = [FK] 完整教學：[digit] [量詞] [補充]
keep post_title English; Chinese goes in rank_math_title
rows.source: The author's site habit; reason (CJK font / breakage) never measured

rows.rule: no <script type=application/ld+json> in content; the author's site theme printed it as text
rows.source: The author's site incident; no saved reproduction

rows.rule: no "HowTo Schema"/"FAQ Schema" text in H2 headings
HowTo JSON sizeSlug "large" (plugin default "full"; save() ignores it)
omit hasDuration/days/hours/minutes/titleWrapper from HowTo JSON (they are valid plugin attributes; save() ignores them)
opening blockquote in natural conversational Chinese

rows.rank_math_test: contentHasAssets counts the featured image as 1 image

rows.rule: write article files with LF on Windows (newline='\n')
wp post update ID file.html instead of --post_content=$(cat ...)
